definitions.explanation: The young, edible shoot of a bamboo plant. A prized spring ingredient in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: {筍|たけのこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掘|ほ}る→掘る：00442_horu⟧。

examples.english: Bamboo shoots come into season when spring arrives.

examples.japanese: {採|と}れたて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{筍|たけのこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{米|こめ}ぬか→米ぬか：30492_komenuka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{茹|ゆ}でて→茹でる：02324_yuderu⟧アク⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}いた→抜く：02384_nuku⟧。
examples.english: I boiled the freshly harvested bamboo shoots with rice bran to remove the bitterness.

notes:
WRITING:
Usually written in hiragana as たけのこ or in kanji as {筍|たけのこ}. The kanji {竹|たけ}の{子|こ} (literally "child of bamboo") is also seen but less common than the single-character form.

USAGE:
{筍|たけのこ} is a quintessential spring ingredient in Japan. Fresh shoots require preparation — they must be boiled with ⟦{米|こめ}ぬか→米ぬか：30492_komenuka⟧ (rice bran) or ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とぎ{汁|じる} (rice washing water) to remove their astringent flavor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {筍|たけのこ}⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧: bamboo shoot rice
- {筍|たけのこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧: simmered bamboo shoots
- {筍|たけのこ}⟦{掘|ほ}り→掘る：00442_horu⟧: bamboo shoot digging
- {筍|たけのこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{土佐煮|とさに}: bamboo shoots simmered in bonito-flavored broth
